notes: Former MAPS['arena_bay5'] literal of validate_native_features.py, moved to data by PLAN-AIRPIT item 3.
implicit_scene_identity: the released Bay5 schema-1 packages predate source.map_key; that exact scene set is the only implicit identity the validator accepts.
features is null on purpose: Bay5 keeps shape-only validation of the optional native_features entries (its decal count moved from 499 to 502 with Arena 0.6.0, so it is not pinned).
states is null: the schema-1 audio graph records no hierarchy states; every player must be a member of some group.
